english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an object's external surface or a general flat surface.
Use this when you mean the object's visible or physical outer surface specifically.

examples.english: There is some water on the surface of the table.
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 biu2 min6 jau5 di1 seoi2

examples.english: The exterior of the table has lots of scratches.
examples.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 biu2 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gwaat3 han4
